rounds.text: Om Galaxy Ltd demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency, consistently delivering a 3-year median return on equity of 25% [E17] and a current ROCE of 23.81% [E9], both of which vastly outperform the sector benchmarks of 6.34% and 6.16% respectively [E8, E9]. The company’s operational quality is further evidenced by a strong cash conversion ratio of 2.06x, confirming that reported profits are fully backed by actual cash flow [E22]. Management is actively positioning for future expansion, as evidenced by a 1500% surge in capital work-in-progress to Rs 16 Cr [E28] and a notable improvement in working capital efficiency, with requirements dropping from 52.5 days to 22.7 days [E40]. The market appears to be significantly mispricing this growth potential, as the current share price implies only 6.4% earnings growth compared to the 17% base case assumption [E35], resulting in a substantial margin of safety of 53.7% [E34]. Conceded: the company faces a sector headwind [E46], a negative free cash flow of Rs 12 Cr [E24], and an increase in borrowings to Rs 38 Cr [E27]. Despite these pressures, the company’s ability to grow profits by 17% over three years [E15] while expanding operating margins by 5 percentage points [E19] highlights a business model that is fundamentally stronger than its current valuation suggests.
